comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Landed in 938b713. Composition is records in crates/muster-core/src/composition.rs, judged by corpus/conformance/composition.json - 16 cases, and all nine deliberate breakages of the implementation were caught.

Both inversions the card named are done: one mirror and one subscription per daemon, and the control socket is per pane. The attached-pane map is nested by daemon rather than keyed by a (daemon, pane) pair, because building a pair key means cloning both ids on a path that runs per keystroke.

Two things went further than the card asked, both because the shape forced the question:

- Attach asks the daemon where a pane lives before building anything. A region shows a tab and only the daemon knows which tab a pane is in, so the alternative was a region in a pending state that landings 4 and 5 would each have to handle. It costs one local round trip on the launch path and buys a refusal by name: 'muster w9:p9' used to open a window that rendered nothing and dropped every keystroke.
- reconcile trims the attached-pane map as well as the regions. Each entry owns a bound socket and the thread waiting on it, so a window whose panes churn would have collected both.

Deliberately left out: nothing here is emitted to the shell yet, and composition grew no change vocabulary. ViewChanged in landing 4 is whole-view and idempotent, so a diff vocabulary would be a guess at what a reader wants rather than an answer to one.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The core owns composition and does not have one yet. Two things in the
code already say so in their own comments: the mirror is a static
because there is one window and one daemon, and its subscription hangs
off the attached pane rather than off the daemon it describes.

What this needs to become is which daemons are attached, and which
(daemon, workspace, tab) shows in which window region - plus view-local
focus, meaning which pane Muster's keyboard feeds, which is never read
back from the daemon's own cursor.

Keep it plain records (a_27QcqNxRB). This is the only durable state
Muster has and it is a few hundred bytes; written as records it can be
saved later for nothing, and written as a graph of view objects it
cannot be saved at all.

Also here: the control socket is one per process today and has to
become one per pane.
title: 🗂️ Composition: which daemon, which tab, which region
